predictors.constant: Laplace-smoothed frequency of identified training labels
predictors.selection: Load the exact AP1 selected joblib bundles; no fit, selection or refit in AP2

panels: Seven-day ORIGIN blocks from evaluation start, with P+K-1 underlying records for P scored origins; last partial origin block included. Annual bounds solved separately, never summed from weekly bounds.
pairwise_method: Derive all implications between ambiguous window labels from feasible run witnesses, independent of predictions and outcomes; solve the corresponding order-polytope LP with a compact interval graph

artificial.selection: Earliest longest naturally complete evaluation run, truncated by dataset limit
artificial.hidden_truth_use: Only after predictions for containment and false-direction checks

benchmark.jit_timing: Separate from warm kernel; identical warm/cold policy for both graphs

milp_sampling: For each study/dataset/K/scope/mask and combination of ambiguity, tightening and independent direction, pick lexicographically first panel ID before looking at MILP results; at most 24 panels; solve all 3 pairs per selected panel; 60 seconds per optimization, report cutoffs

numeric.near_zero: Recompute DP on an integer grid with conservative error enclosure before strict sign decisions; no statistical-confidence interpretation

claim_selection: Lock only claims supported by nearest-neighbor baselines, held-out-year natural results, candidate-set changes and explicit negative cases; no requirement to obtain positive results

structure.large_component: Unresolved unless an explicit unreachable pairwise-valid pattern is certified; no sampling-based sufficiency claims

witnesses.scope: Every AP1 and AP2 natural undirected comparison; every ambiguous comparison endpoint
witnesses.public_payload: Only missing-bit assignments, not observed measurements or prediction arrays
witnesses.sign_check: Exact rational sum over stored IEEE prediction values for witness signs
